mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS ID, USER_NM, ENPSWD, ACNT_STTS_CD, AUTHRT_CD FROM ADMIN_MST WHERE USER_ID = #{id}

SELECT R.RSVT_SN, R.RSVT_NO, R.SCHL_NM, R.SCYR_NM, R.RSVT_YMD, R.VST_HM, R.RSVT_NOPE, R.ACTL_NOPE, R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD, CASE R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD WHEN 'MISSION' THEN '미션' WHEN 'EXPLORE' THEN '사건탐구' ELSE R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD END AS PRGRM_TYPE_NM, R.PRGRM_SN, P.PRGRM_NM, P.TRGT_CN, P.TOTAL_TM_MNT, P.MAX_NOPE, P.SIMPLE_EXPLN, P.START_EXPLN, P.TEAM_CNT, P.ROUTE_JSON, P.STEP_JSON, P.EVAL_JSON, R.LRN_STTS_CD, CASE R.LRN_STTS_CD WHEN 'READY' THEN '진행 전' WHEN 'ING' THEN '진행 중' WHEN 'DONE' THEN '완료' ELSE R.LRN_STTS_CD END AS LRN_STTS_NM, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT S WHERE S.RSVT_SN = R.RSVT_SN AND S.DEL_DT IS NULL ) AS STDNT_CNT FROM EDU_RSVT_MST R LEFT JOIN EDU_PRGRM_MST P ON P.PRGRM_SN = R.PRGRM_SN AND P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD = R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD WHERE R.RSVT_YMD = #{rsvtYmd} AND R.DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY ABS(TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(CAST(R.VST_HM AS TIME), CAST(#{currentHm} AS TIME)))) ASC, CASE WHEN CAST(R.VST_HM AS TIME) >= CAST(#{currentHm} AS TIME) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, CAST(R.VST_HM AS TIME) ASC, R.RSVT_SN DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT STDNT_SN, RSVT_SN, STDNT_NO, CLAS_NM, CLAS_NO, STDNT_NM, ATND_YN, TEAM_NM, ASGN_NM, ROUTE_CN, LRN_STTS_CD, PRGRS_RT FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT WHERE RSVT_SN = #{rsvtSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(STDNT_NO, ''), STDNT_SN) AS UNSIGNED), STDNT_SN
mapper.sql: C.CNTN_SN, C.CNTN_TYPE_CD, CASE C.CNTN_TYPE_CD WHEN 'INFO' THEN '정보안내' WHEN 'VIDEO' THEN '애니메이션 영상' WHEN 'SELECT' THEN '선택형 활동' WHEN 'DATA' THEN '데이터 입력' WHEN 'PHOTO' THEN '사진 업로드' WHEN 'SENTENCE' THEN '문장완성형' ELSE C.CNTN_TYPE_CD END AS CNTN_TYPE_NM, C.CARD_CLSF_CD, CASE C.CARD_CLSF_CD WHEN 'MISSION' THEN '미션카드' WHEN 'EXPLORE' THEN '탐구카드' WHEN 'EXPERIENCE' THEN '체험카드' WHEN 'DESIGN' THEN '설계활동' WHEN 'MAKER' THEN '메이커활동' ELSE C.CARD_CLSF_CD END AS CARD_CLSF_NM, C.CNTN_TTL, C.CNTN_CN, C.PRVD_TYPE_CD, CASE C.PRVD_TYPE_CD WHEN 'IMAGE' THEN '이미지' WHEN 'VIDEO' THEN '동영상' ELSE C.PRVD_TYPE_CD END AS PRVD_TYPE_NM, C.IMG_ATCH_FILE_ID, C.VIDEO_URL_ADDR, C.VIDEO_THMB_ATCH_FILE_ID, C.VIDEO_TTL

SELECT STDNT_SN, STEP_CD, ACTVT_NM, STEP_STTS_CD FROM EDU_LRN_PRGRS_LOG WHERE RSVT_SN = #{rsvtSn} AND STEP_STTS_CD = 'DONE' ORDER BY STDNT_SN ASC, STEP_CD ASC

SELECT LRN_ANS_SN, RSVT_SN, STDNT_SN, ANS_TYPE_CD, STEP_CD, CNTN_SN, QSTNR_SN, QSTN_SN, QSTN_CN, ANS_CN FROM EDU_LRN_ANS WHERE RSVT_SN = #{rsvtSn} AND ANS_TYPE_CD IN ('WORKSHEET', 'HERO', 'EVALUATION', 'SURVEY') AND DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY STDNT_SN ASC, STEP_CD ASC, LRN_ANS_SN ASC

SELECT Q.QSTNR_SN, M.QSTNR_NM, Q.QSTN_SN, Q.QSTN_NO, Q.ANS_TYPE_CD, CASE Q.ANS_TYPE_CD WHEN 'LIKERT5' THEN '리커트 5점' WHEN 'LEVEL5' THEN '상중하 5단계' WHEN 'TEXT' THEN '주관식' ELSE Q.ANS_TYPE_CD END AS ANS_TYPE_NM, Q.QSTN_CN, Q.SORT_SEQ FROM EDU_QSTNR_QSTN Q INNER JOIN EDU_QSTNR_MST M ON M.QSTNR_SN = Q.QSTNR_SN WHERE Q.QSTNR_SN = #{qstnrSn} AND M.QSTNR_TYPE_CD = #{qstnrTypeCd} AND M.DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY Q.SORT_SEQ ASC, Q.QSTN_SN ASC

SELECT Q.QSTNR_SN, M.QSTNR_NM, Q.QSTN_SN, Q.QSTN_NO, Q.ANS_TYPE_CD, CASE Q.ANS_TYPE_CD WHEN 'LIKERT5' THEN '리커트 5점' WHEN 'LEVEL5' THEN '상중하 5단계' WHEN 'TEXT' THEN '주관식' ELSE Q.ANS_TYPE_CD END AS ANS_TYPE_NM, Q.QSTN_CN, Q.SORT_SEQ FROM EDU_QSTNR_QSTN Q INNER JOIN EDU_QSTNR_MST M ON M.QSTNR_SN = Q.QSTNR_SN WHERE M.QSTNR_NM = #{qstnrNm} AND M.QSTNR_TYPE_CD = #{qstnrTypeCd} AND M.DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY Q.SORT_SEQ ASC, Q.QSTN_SN ASC

SELECT B.PST_SN, B.PST_TTL, B.PST_CN, B.ETC1 AS LRN_TYPE_CD, CASE B.ETC1 WHEN 'PRE' THEN '사전학습' WHEN 'MAIN' THEN '본학습' WHEN 'POST' THEN '사후학습' ELSE B.ETC1 END AS LRN_TYPE_NM, B.ETC2 AS DATA_TYPE_CD, CASE B.ETC2 WHEN 'LINK' THEN '링크' WHEN 'DOC' THEN '문서' WHEN 'VIDEO' THEN '동영상' ELSE B.ETC2 END AS DATA_TYPE_NM, B.ETC3 AS PRGRM_TYPE_CD, CASE B.ETC3 WHEN 'MISSION' THEN '미션' WHEN 'EXPLORE' THEN '사건탐구' ELSE B.ETC3 END AS PRGRM_TYPE_NM, CAST(NULLIF(B.ETC4, '') AS UNSIGNED) AS PRGRM_SN, P.PRGRM_NM, B.LNKG_URL_ADDR AS LINK_URL, B.ETC5 AS VIDEO_EMBED_URL, B.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO, F.FILE_SEQ, F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM AS FILE_URL, F.ORGNL_FILE_NM, B.PSTG_YMD FROM BBS_ARTICLE B LEFT JOIN EDU_PRGRM_MST P ON P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD = B.ETC3 AND P.PRGRM_SN = CAST(NULLIF(B.ETC4, '') AS UNSIGNED) AND P.DEL_DT IS NULL LEFT JOIN ATCH_FILE_INFO F ON F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = B.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO WHERE B.BBS_ID = 'LRNSUP' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.ETC1 = 'MAIN' AND B.ETC3 = #{prgrmTypeCd} AND CAST(NULLIF(B.ETC4, '') AS UNSIGNED) = #{prgrmSn} ORDER BY B.PSTG_YMD DESC, B.REG_DT DESC, B.PST_SN DESC, F.FILE_SEQ ASC

SELECT CALL_SN, RSVT_SN, TEAM_NM, STDNT_NMS AS STUDENT_NAMES, STDNT_CNT AS STUDENT_COUNT, PLACE_NM, CALL_CN, CALL_STTS_CD, CASE CALL_STTS_CD WHEN 'READ' THEN '읽음' ELSE '대기' END AS CALL_STTS_NM, DATE_FORMAT(REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DT, DATE_FORMAT(READ_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS READ_DT FROM EDU_TCHR_CALL WHERE RSVT_SN = #{rsvtSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY REG_DT DESC, CALL_SN DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_TCHR_CALL ( RSVT_SN, TEAM_NM, STDNT_NMS, STDNT_CNT, PLACE_NM, CALL_CN, CALL_STTS_CD, RGTR_NM, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{rsvtSn}, #{teamNm}, #{studentNames}, #{studentCount}, #{placeNm}, #{callCn}, 'WAIT', 'tablet', NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_TCHR_CALL SET CALL_STTS_CD = 'READ', READ_DT = COALESCE(READ_DT, NOW()), MDFR_NM = 'tablet', MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE CALL_SN = #{callSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL
UPDATE EDU_TCHR_CALL SET CALL_STTS_CD = 'READ', READ_DT = COALESCE(READ_DT, NOW()), MDFR_NM = 'tablet', MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE RSVT_SN = #{rsvtSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL AND CALL_STTS_CD != 'READ'
mapper.select: SELECT M.MSG_SN, M.RSVT_SN, M.TRGT_NM AS TARGET_NM, M.STDNT_CNT AS STUDENT_COUNT, M.MSG_CN AS MESSAGE_CN, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN R.READ_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS READ_COUNT, DATE_FORMAT(M.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DT FROM EDU_TCHR_MSG M LEFT JOIN EDU_TCHR_MSG_RCPT R ON R.MSG_SN = M.MSG_SN AND R.DEL_DT IS NULL WHERE M.RSVT_SN = #{rsvtSn} AND M.DEL_DT IS NULL GROUP BY M.MSG_SN, M.RSVT_SN, M.TRGT_NM, M.STDNT_CNT, M.MSG_CN, M.REG_DT ORDER BY M.REG_DT DESC, M.MSG_SN DESC
